boundary_separation.logic_only_dc: compute/control/interface area and timing only; zero storage macro area; never total

future_aggregation.total_energy: E_logic_axis + E_ext_dyn_axis + E_ext_leak_axis + symmetric residual common-model term
future_aggregation.no_double_count: Every storage row has internal_charge + external_charge == exactly one for each axis
